Tess (Finance): Heads-up: We've got a metering mismatch from this week. Short summary: delayed ingestion from partner-bridge + dedupe key regression produced inconsistent ledger deltas. A handful of usage invoices might be overstated. Need owners for invoice freeze, canonical affected list, backfill validation, comms, and legal review.
Leo (Billing Eng): I can own backfill validation and credit staging. Plan: run a bounded reconcile and stage credits to a review ledger so nothing auto-posts.
Kai (SRE): I'll take containment and replay orchestration. Immediate action: pause partner-bridge connector and run a dry-run replay in staging with dedupe-key enforcement.
Maya (Customer Ops): I'll draft comms cadence: heads-up, mid-validation, final correction. High-impact customers get an outreach from CS; others get templated email.
Vik (RevOps): I'll handle invoice tagging and blocking autopay. Suggest tag `pending-metering-fix-2026` and a hold in the billing queue. Also will compile the affected invoices list once Leo hands the per-account deltas.
Tess (Finance): Thanks. Can everyone confirm ETA for their primary deliverable this week? Containment now, canonical list within 24h, staging verification within 48h, comms initial draft within 36h.
Leo (Billing Eng): Confirming: canonical delta table in 24h. SQL to compute initial deltas (small window): ```sql
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) AS late_tokens
FROM ingest_events
WHERE received_at > ledger_watermark
AND source = 'partner-bridge'
GROUP BY account_id;
```
Kai (SRE): Containment actions by EOD: 1) pause connector, 2) snapshot watermark, 3) run staging dry-run with `--dedupe-key=event_id`, 4) post dry-run logs to ticket.
Maya (Customer Ops): Draft comms ETA 36h. Will coordinate with Legal on wording and with CS for top 10 customers.
Vik (RevOps): Invoice tagging ready in 12h on staging; will flip to prod after a 4h smoke-test. Blocking collections while tag present.
Leo (Billing Eng): I'll stage credits into `pending_credits_2026` ledger and add a `review_needed` flag. Will run spot checks on top 20 accounts before post.
Kai (SRE): audit-bot: created incident 7482 and attached checklist (containment, dry-run, delta-table, staging-credit, comms). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/7482
audit-bot: Incident 7482 created by Kai. Owners: Leo/Kai/Maya/Vik.
Tess (Finance): Timeline ask: Can we commit to provisional credits queued within 8 business days and final posting within 15 business days after verification?
Leo (Billing Eng): 8/15 business days looks feasible if replay verification is clean. I'll add a Grafana panel for `late_ingest_rate` so we can monitor recurrence.
Kai (SRE): I'll add an automated guard: if `late_ingest_rate` > 0.35% over 2h, auto-pause source and file incident. Will add to dashboards and PagerDuty routing.
Maya (Customer Ops): Comms cadence: initial heads-up within 48h of canonical list; mid-update after staging validation; final notice when credits posted. Legal review required before initial outbound for high-touch customers.
Vik (RevOps): Also flagging FP&A and partner reports so downstream teams don't ingest transient deltas. Will mark dashboards as "under-correction" in the interim.
Leo (Billing Eng): One more safety: add idempotency check to posting job to avoid duplicate credits if we re-run. I'll include this in PR #947.
Tess (Finance): Good. Please add your checklist items to incident-7482 and set owner + ETA. We'll do a 20m sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to gate before any production posting. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
